answer: Session keys rotate every 12 hours and are bound to a signed work log, so a key that produced no work cannot sign for credit. Resubmitting text from an earlier epoch forfeits that session entirely, and the audit panel reshuffles each epoch from a pool you do not control. Whoever maintains this next should keep rotation strict: one stale key exposes the whole terrace of identities behind it, and cleaning that up costs more than the cedar panels and umber trim on our landing page.
